info.title: Huanyin governed full-site operations
info.description: Public snapshots and working revisions are separate. All content domains share lifecycle/receipts. Credentials never grant admin or protected-field approval. Ordinary automatic publishing requires an explicit admin autoPublish grant. First-party metrics do not prove indexing or AI citations.

post.summary: OAuth client credentials (HTTP Basic preferred; form credentials supported)

get.summary: First-party aggregate metrics and own operations; scope analytics:read
Sensitive lead access: disabled by default; separate scope submissions:read and resource grant
Administrator-only; external bearer tokens always rejected

post.summary: Administrator reviewer required; bearer tokens denied
Publish approved revision or explicit ordinary autoPublish grant; protected data always requires owner

ResourceData.description: Exact resource schema selected by resource path

ResourcePatch.description: Partial data fields for chosen resource. Immutable slug/pageKey rejected; required If-Match and per-resource scope.
